$comment: One Drive folder feeds /library. 'root.folderId' is the folder's ID (drive.google.com/drive/folders/<ID>). Everything inside is sorted automatically: a top-level subfolder whose name matches 'researchPattern' becomes Research; otherwise a file goes by type (PDF, Presentations); anything else lands in 'Other files'. Folder IDs are not secrets. With no credentials the page offers Drive's own folder view; add GOOGLE_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON) as a repository secret to index the files. Share the folder as 'Anyone with the link: Viewer'. Per-collection folderId is still supported if you later split into separate folders.
